errors.what: clan patch-html appended fragment to end of body instead of replacing the selector target; also caused SHA256 mismatch in manifest
errors.recovered_by: Directly patched human/index.html in zip: removed appended duplicate, replaced original element with correct y/height values; recomputed SHA256 and updated manifest.yaml

problems_and_friction: clan patch-html with YAML frontmatter selector did not replace the matched element in-place; instead it appended the fragment to the end of the body, creating a duplicate id. Recovery required direct zip manipulation to fix the HTML and update the manifest SHA256. The patch-html CLI selector syntax may not support CSS selector-based replacement when passed via frontmatter.
context_understood: Hop 06 updates the SVG cost chart so bar-zoho reflects y=78 height=82, making Zoho visually cheapest in the bar chart to match the price drop established in hop 01.
